name: Channel 3 - World In A Box (realistic cut-away builds)
about: Reference: World In A Box ('How a Well Becomes a Secret Bunker', 'How a Flooded House Becomes a Floating Home', 'How a Bookshelf Becomes a Secret Panic Room', 'How a Hole on a Beach Becomes a Tsunami Tower'). Realistic 3D diorama sliced open side-on: grass on top, soil, gravel and rock bands below, rooms with the front wall removed. One realistic builder (hard hat or hoodie, jeans) does each build step on screen; water fills and drains; a car or neighbour for scale. 'How an ordinary thing becomes a clever survival build', 60-72 s, one-word captions centre screen.

look.materials: Poly Haven CC0 PBR: grass, soil, gravel, rock, stone wall, brick, wood planks, plaster, tile, water
look.camera: mostly side-on cut-away (front wall/soil removed), slow pushes and tilts down the cross-section, a few 3/4 outside views

paint_style: Realistic 3D architectural cut-away render, soft daylight, PBR materials, clean white interiors
formula: hook: the ordinary thing in its world (a house by a river, a well in a field) + 'How does X become Y?'
the threat: water, intruders, storm, shown hitting the plain version
the build: one step per line, the builder doing it in the cut-away (dig, line, brace, seal, fit a door)
the clever twist: a hidden mechanism moves (floats, slides, swings open)
the test: the threat comes back and the build holds; last line loops to the first
worlds_planned: field_well (ground slice + stone shaft + water table)
riverside_house (open-front house on soil slice, river, rising water)
apartment_section (two floors, brick party wall, bookshelf)
